definitions: The feeling of being upset or annoyed, especially because of inability to change or achieve something.
The prevention of the progress, success, or fulfilment of something.
A legal doctrine by which a contract is terminated if an unforeseen event makes its performance impossible or radically different from what was originally intended.
examples: She felt a deep sense of frustration.
The project was met with constant frustration.
The frustration of the contract led to legal action.
